card.title: LAST RITES
card.text: Shuffle 8 KAMIKAZE cards into your deck.
card.flavorText: Before kamikaze pilots departed on their final missions they were given military decorations and ceremonies were carried out where they shared ceremonial cups of sake or water known as “mizu no sakazuki”. The pilots would also compose and read a death poem, a tradition stemming from the samurai’s, who did so before committing seppuku. The kamikaze pilot would wear a “senninbari”, a "belt of a thousand stitches" given to them by their mothers and carry prayers from their families on the final mission. In the final moments before impact, the pilot was to yell "hissatsu" which translates to "certain kill".
